name: Dr Anojian Koneshamoorthy
title: Dr / Endocrinologist (AK)
description: Private endocrinologist who 'welcomes referrals across all areas of endocrinology, including ... gender-affirming care'; Endocrinology Melbourne lists transgender health / gender-affirming hormone therapy (testosterone and estrogen) as a service. Specialist referral from GP required. Also an endocrinologist in the Austin Health public Gender Clinic (adults 18+, GP referral, shared care).
specialties: Gender-affirming care, diabetes, thyroid, men's health, bone and mineral, pituitary, adrenal

name: Monash Health Gender Clinic
title: Public gender service
description: Statewide public specialist service for trans, gender diverse and non-binary Victorians aged 16+. After assessment with clinic clinicians, clients can be referred to Monash Health Endocrinology for gender-affirming hormone therapy (does not take over hormone care started elsewhere). Referral from a GP or specialist via HealthLink eReferral required; no cost for Medicare card holders. Very long waitlist (Oct 2026: booking referrals received June 2024).
specialties: Gender assessment, gender-affirming hormone therapy (via Monash Health Endocrinology), surgery referral, voice, laser hair removal
